z: 我有一份工资很高工作时间理想的工作.
e: I have a good-paying job with excellent hours.

z: 每个星期二下午是这个教授的办公时间。
e: The professor has office hours every Tuesday afternoon.

z: 他的分数总比我高，尽管他学习得少一点。
e: His scores are always better than mine, even though he doesn't study very much.

z: 只有能提出新问题的回答才是有用的回答。
e: The only useful answers are those that raise new questions.

z: 我们将要整理房间，这样妈妈就会满意了。
e: We will tidy up our room so that Mom is satisfied.

z: 就目前情况看，我们不能按时完成任务了。
e: Judging from the current situation, we cannot complete the task in time.

z: 根据时间表，这个任务应该在这周内结束。
e: According to schedule, this task should be finished within this week.

z: 我们的工作人员会在三个工作日内联系您。
e: Our staff will contact you in three working days.

z: 它的感觉像是它把你吸到了另外一个世界。
e: It feels like it's going to absorb you into another world.

z: 房间里的所有人都同时看了看自己的手表。
e: Everyone in the room checked their watches at the same time.

z: 做人如果没有梦想，那和咸鱼有什么区别？
e: Without dreams, what different are we from animals?

z: 当我进入那个房间的时候，她正在弹钢琴。
e: When I entered the room, she was playing the piano.

z: 我说完所有需要说的话后，感觉轻松多了。
e: After saying everything that I had to, I felt relaxed.

z: 他很高兴能通过各种方法在人生中取得成功。
e: He was glad to avail himself of any means to succeed in life.

z: 大部分人写的东西是关于他们的日常生活的。
e: Most people write about their daily life.

z: 这件衬衫我不喜欢。把另外一件给我看一下。
e: I don't like this shirt. Show me another.

z: 按照这个速度，我们不会在这周结束前完成。
e: At this rate, we're not likely to be done before the end of the week.

z: 难道我没有告诉你演唱会的时候要早点去吗？
e: I thought I told you that you should get to the concert early.

z: 由于错过了火车，我不得不等下一班等一小时。
e: As I missed the train, I had to wait for the next one for about an hour.

z: 对我来说，努力学习就是最好取得成功的办法。
e: In my view, studying hard is the best way to achieve success.

z: 你可以来提货，我们也可以把商品送到您那里。
e: You can come pick up the goods, or we can bring them to you.

z: 买了不想要的东西，往往得要卖掉想要的东西。
e: He that buys what he does not want, must often sell what he does want.

z: 我家里有个老年人突然倒在地上，大概是中风了。
e: An elderly person in my family suddenly fell to the ground; he likely suffered a stroke.

z: 在我们讨论问题的过程中，我想到了一个好主意。
e: While we were discussing the problem, I hit upon a good idea.

z: 种一棵树，最好的时间是20年前，其次是现在。
e: The best time to plant a tree is 20 years ago. The second best time is now.

z: 在一个下雨的早晨，他很早出门为的是及时到学校。
e: On a rainy morning, he left his house early so as to be in time for school.

z: 21世纪社会，不懂电脑不懂外语往往会步步难行。
e: In the 21st century, it will be hard to survive if you don't know how to use a computer or if you don't know any foreign languages.

z: 别人可以随便怎么想，只要他们的想法与我的相同。
e: Other people can think what they want, as long as they think like I do.

z: 既然房间里新家具都买好了，这点破家具都可以丢掉了！
e: Now that we've bought new furniture for the room, why not throw away this old, worn-out furniture?

z: 别人建议我坐飞机而不是坐船去，于是我选择了坐飞机。
e: I was told to go not by boat but by plane, which advice I followed.

z: 当我是个孩子的时候，我会把大部分时间都用于室内阅读。
e: When I was a child, I spent most of my time indoors reading.

z: 只有那样技术的国家，还想要做汽车，我们十分无法理解。
e: It is incomprehensible to us that a country with that level of technology would even think of making an automobile.

z: 尽管他是一周前才开始学中文的，然而他已经认识很多字了。
e: Despite the fact that he has only just started learning Chinese, he already knows lots of characters.
